info.title: API-DocTest-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Status Retrieval API enables users to access the current status of event tickets within the ticketing system. This endpoint provides crucial information regarding whether tickets are available, sold out, or reserved, allowing event organizers and customers to monitor ticket availability effectively. Typical consumers include event planners, ticketing system integrations, and customer service representatives looking to assist users with their ticket inquiries. By leveraging this API, businesses can streamline the ticketing process and enhance customer satisfaction through timely updates.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a ticket.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of a specific ticket in the system. It ensures that users have up-to-date information regarding their tickets, which can help in better managing their workflow and addressing any issues that may arise.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the status of tickets. It should be formatted according to the defined schema and includes necessary parameters to retrieve the status information effectively.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of ticket operations in a JSON format.

status.description: Indicates the success of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique number to reference the ticket.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the ticket.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: Response schema for the status of tickets operations.

createdBy.description: User or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket was created automatically.

Audit.description: Contains the audit information for tracking purposes.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.
